name: exempt

repo.env_config:
[project]
name = "Flask-WTF"
description = "Form rendering, validation, and CSRF protection for Flask with WTForms."
readme = "README.rst"
classifiers = [ "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable", "Environment :: Web Environment", "Intended Audience :: Developers", "License :: OSI Approved :: BSD License", "Operating System :: OS Independent", "Programming Language :: Python", "Topic :: Internet :: WWW/HTTP :: Dynamic Content", "Topic :: Internet :: WWW/HTTP :: WSGI", "Topic :: Internet :: WWW/HTTP :: WSGI :: Application", "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Application Frameworks",]
requires-python = ">=3.9"
dependencies = [ "Flask", "WTForms", "itsdangerous",]
dynamic = [ "version",]
version = "0.1.0"
[[project.maintainers]]
name = "WTForms"

[build-system]
requires = [ "hatchling",]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project.license]
file = "LICENSE.rst"

[project.urls]
Documentation = "https://flask-wtf.readthedocs.io/"
Changes = "https://flask-wtf.readthedocs.io/changes/"
"Source Code" = "https://github.com/pallets-eco/flask-wtf/"
"Issue Tracker" = "https://github.com/pallets-eco/flask-wtf/issues/"
Chat = "https://discord.gg/pallets"

[project.optional-dependencies]
email = [ "email_validator",]

[tool.ruff]
src = [ "src",]
fix = true
show-fixes = true
output-format = "full"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [ "B", "E", "F", "I", "UP", "W",]

[tool.hatch.build]
include = [ "src/", "docs/", "tests/", "CHANGES.rst", "tox.ini",]
exclude = [ "docs/_build/",]

[tool.hatch.version]
path = "src/flask_wtf/__init__.py"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = [ "tests",]
filterwarnings = [ "error",]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
source = [ "flask_wtf", "tests",]

[tool.coverage.paths]
source = [ "src", "*/site-packages",]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [ "pragma: no cover", "except ImportError:",]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
force-single-line = true
order-by-type = false

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [ "src/flask_wtf",]

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
pytest = "^8.4.2"
pytest-cov = "^7.0.0"
pytest-reportlog = "^0.4.0"
icontract = "^2.7.1"
